description: Find institutional recipients by name substring in the Police Grant Register's DOJ COPS award lists for FY2020–FY2026. Returns each recipient's award rows by program and fiscal year, reviewed DOJ-list and ICE 287(g) match labels, and any DOJ equitable-sharing payments side by side. COPS, JAG formula allocations and forfeiture payments are never added. 'No COPS award appears in lists for FY2020–FY2026' never means an agency gets no federal money; absence covers only the published COPS lists. Award lists do not record application scoring or money paid out.

recipient.description: Required case-insensitive recipient name substring, at most 80 characters.
